The core module (explainability-core) provides fairness metrics, AI explainers, and XAI utilities as a reusable Java library published via Maven. While it also contains an explainability-service module (a Quarkus REST service that wraps the library for containerized deployment), and includes a Dockerfile to produce a runnable image, the project's primary identity and artifact is the library itself. The service module is one consumer of the core library, not the project's raison d'être.
